findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：Volkswagen 占營收 13%（2024 年 10%、2023 年 11%），Ford 12%（13%、14%）；無其他單一客戶超過 10%。
findings.excerpt: Volkswagen 13 % 10 % 11 % Ford 12 % 13 % 14 % No other single customer accounted for more than 10% of the Company’s consolidated net sales in any of the years presented. Sales to the Company’s top ten customers represented 71% of sales for the year ended December 31, 2025.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：前十大客戶占 2025 年營收 71%，供貨合約多為需求合約，失去主要客戶或其車款大幅減產會對業務造成不成比例的重大不利影響。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A. Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Sales to the Company’s top ten customers represented 71% of sales for the year ended December 31, 2025. Changes in our business relationships with any of our major customers or in the timing, size and continuation of their various programs could have a disproportionately material adverse impact on our business.

findings.claim: Volkswagen 集團評等頁：Moody's 2025-03 由 A3 降至 Baa1，之後展望轉負；S&P BBB+ 展望負面。
findings.excerpt: agency Standard & Poor’s confirmed its short-term and long-term ratings for Volkswagen AG of A–2 and BBB+ respectively. However, the outlook was revised down from “stable” to “negative”. In March 2025, Moody’s Investors Service downgraded the long-term rating by one notch, from A3 to Baa1.

findings.claim: Ford 2026 Q2 後上調全年調整後 EBIT 指引至 100-110 億美元、自由現金流 60-70 億美元。
findings.excerpt: Per l'intero 2026 La società ha alzato le previsioni di EBIT rettificato a 10-11 miliardi (da 8,5-10,5 miliardi) e del flusso di cassa libero rettificato a 6-7 miliardi (da 5-6 miliardi di dollari).
